name: exec-1020-citing-groups
decision: Ok sesuai, masukan exec (2026-10-20); Ya oke, jalankan semua end to end
change: Fast prefix (AI_FASTLANE_GOAL_ANSWERS): CITING AND CHECKS in five groups (answer shape, tool arguments, data lifetime and recovery, evidence, reproduction) with ids copied exactly, expiry recovery, kept working tables, same-as claims naming what differs, statistics in the model's own code by default; rule 13 table rows up to fifty (M185). Standard prefix unchanged.
